authority_note: Model behaviour resources are the ONLY layer that may vary because a different model was selected (§51.3). They adapt execution guidance; they may never alter engineering truth, acceptance criteria, security constraints or Project Truth. A resource that would change what is correct is a defect, not an optimisation.

precedence.note: §57. A lower-level optimisation may never weaken a higher-level requirement. Conflict resolution walks this order and the higher entry wins.

rules: Verify only currently uncertain facts whose falsity would materially change the action, target, safety or result.
Prefer cheap direct observation over speculation.
Reuse fresh authoritative evidence rather than re-deriving it.
Scale reasoning depth to task risk.
resources.rationale: §18/§19. Addresses the observed Opus failure modes of overthinking and premature action on plausible assumptions.

rules: Do not restate context or duplicate completed work.
Do not narrate intermediate reasoning that does not change the result.
Stop once acceptance criteria are met.
resources.rationale: §18. Negative activation often saves more tokens than adding positive instruction (§58).

rules: Keep the change within the declared task scope.
resources.rationale: §35. Codex benefits from bounded task scope.

rules: Never claim success until the postcondition is observed.
resources.rationale: §35/§43. Codex benefits from explicit postcondition testing.

rules: On failure, make a discriminating observation before changing anything.
Diagnose, apply the smallest repair, then verify.
resources.rationale: §20. Model-agnostic debugging and recovery micro-skill; mirrors .claude/rules/verification-discipline.md.

rules: Preserve infrastructure unrelated to the task.
Do not stylistically reinterpret a locked design.
resources.rationale: §58. Protects DIAL Design Authority under DEC-031.

known_conflicts.note: Concision suppresses narration, not observation. Observation is an action, not commentary.
§57 worked example. Risk profile outranks model-specific optimisation.

stereotype_guard.note: §35. Model failure-mode profiles must be evidence-backed and versioned, and must never harden into immutable stereotypes. Every resource above is EXPERIMENTAL with evidence_hash null: none has yet earned activation, and none may be promoted on the strength of its wording alone (§94).
